description.plain_text: Shadow/midtone/highlight ranges are controlled by lookup curves on the Ranges tab. Setting saturation to zero makes the color equal the gray used for the range. Setting contrast to zero makes the color equal a fixed gray value. You can alter this value by changing the gamma. You can use this to make mattes by setting gain for alpha to zero and setting the offset for alpha to 1 in the range you want a matte for.
description.text:
Shadow/midtone/highlight ranges are controlled by lookup curves on the Ranges tab.
Setting saturation to zero makes the color equal the gray used for the range.
Setting contrast to zero makes the color equal a fixed gray value. You can alter this value by changing the gamma.
You can use this to make mattes by setting gain for alpha to zero and setting the offset for alpha to 1 in the range you want a matte for.
